items.source:
Correctly writes an empty tag if no inner text or nested tags
have been written.
items.translation: 如果未写入内部文本或嵌套标签，则正确写入一个空标签。

items.source: Create a new instance of the TagWriter class that writes to the supplied Writer.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 TagWriter 类实例，该实例将写入提供的 Writer。

items.source: Create a new instance of the TagWriter class that writes to the supplied PageContext.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 TagWriter 类的实例，该实例将写入提供的 PageContext。

items.source: Variant of writeAttribute(String, String) for writing empty HTML attributes without a value such as required.
items.translation: `writeAttribute(String, String)` 的变体，用于写入不带值的空 HTML 属性（如 `required`）。

items.source: Useful when you plan to write additional content in the body outside the context of the current TagWriter.
items.translation: 在计划在当前TagWriter上下文之外编写正文中的额外内容时非常有用。

items.source: Be sure to write all attributes before writing any inner text or nested tags.
items.translation: 请确保在编写任何内文或嵌套标签之前，先写出所有属性 `<strong>`。

items.source: Intended to support output from JSP tag libraries.
items.translation: 旨在支持从 JSP 标签库输出的内容。

items.source: Write an HTML attribute if the supplied value is not null or zero length.
items.translation: 如果提供的值不为null或零长度，则编写一个 HTML 属性。

items.source:
Close the current opening tag (if necessary) and appends the
supplied value as inner text.
items.translation: 关闭当前打开的标签（如有必要），并将提供的值作为内部文本追加。

items.source:
Start a new tag with the supplied name. Leaves the tag open so
that attributes, inner text or nested tags can be written into it.
items.translation: 开始一个带有指定名称的新标签。该标签处于打开状态，以便在其中写入属性、内部文本或嵌套标签。

items.source: pageContext - the JSP PageContext to obtain the Writer from
items.translation: pageContext - 用于从 JSP PageContext 获取 Writer

items.source: writer - the Writer to write tag content to
items.translation: writer - 用于写入标签内容的 Writer

items.source: IllegalStateException - if the opening tag is closed
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果起始标签已关闭

items.source: IllegalStateException - if no tag is open
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果没有打开标签

items.source: enforceClosingTag - whether a full closing tag should be rendered in any case, even in case of a non-block tag
items.translation: enforceClosingTag - 是否在任何情况下都渲染完整的结束标签，即使对于非块级标签也是如此。

items.source: Close the current tag.
items.translation: 关闭当前标签。

items.source: Close the current tag, allowing to enforce a full closing tag.
items.translation: 关闭当前标签，允许强制使用完整闭合标签。

items.source:
Indicate that the currently open tag should be closed and marked
as a block level element.
items.translation: 指示当前打开的标签应被关闭并标记为块级元素。

items.source: Start a new tag with the supplied name.
items.translation: 开始使用提供的名称创建新标签。

items.source: Write an HTML attribute with the specified name and value.
items.translation: 编写具有指定名称和值的 HTML 属性。

items.source: Rob Harrop, Juergen Hoeller
items.translation: Rob Harrop，Juergen Hoeller
